_readme: MIXOMESH material presets — the list the Print ▸ Export ▸ Cost 'Material' menu offers.
Edit this file to add, remove or re-price presets, then restart the app (web: reload; desktop: this is
the copy in your user data folder — the path is shown under the Material menu).
Values typed into the Cost panel change the CURRENT setting only; they are never written back here.
Fields: id (unique, stable), name, process (FDM | Resin | SLS | Full-colour), densityGcm3,
pricePerGram (currency-free number, pair with the Currency field), supportDensityGcm3,
supportPricePerGram, defaultSupportPercent (support volume as % of model volume), note.
Reference prices (USD, 2026 retail, web survey 2026-09-18): PLA 15–30 USD/kg, PETG 20–30, ABS/ASA 25–35,
TPU 18–42, Nylon 30–60, standard 405 nm resin 20–35 USD/L, tough/ABS-like resin 40–60 USD/L,
PA12 SLS powder 70–200 USD/kg. Full-colour inkjet (Mimaki 3DUJ) ink pricing is dealer-quoted — the
0.50 USD/g below is a placeholder to replace with your own quote.

materials.name: PETG
materials.note: Tougher than PLA, some temperature resistance.

materials.name: ASA
materials.note: UV-stable ABS alternative for outdoor parts.

materials.name: TPU 95A (flexible)
materials.note: Flexible; supports are hard to remove, keep them minimal.

materials.name: Standard resin (405 nm)
materials.note: Hobby LCD/MSLA resin; ~25–30 USD per litre.

materials.name: Water-washable resin
materials.note: No IPA wash; slightly more brittle.

materials.name: 8K / miniature resin
materials.note: Low-shrink, fine detail; heavy support use on figures.

materials.name: PA12 nylon (SLS powder)
materials.note: Powder bed needs no supports; density is the sintered part, not the powder.

materials.note: Placeholder price — replace with your dealer quote. Water-soluble support.
